name: Inferior Vena Cava (Abdominal)
description: Abdominal segment of the IVC from the confluence of the common iliac veins (L5) to the diaphragm. Receives renal veins, hepatic veins, and lumbar veins. On CT: assess for thrombosis (renal cell carcinoma extension), IVC filter position, compression, and anomalies (duplicated IVC, left-sided IVC).
